meta.title: My Mom's Day Plan
meta.textType: a day plan with times as words

paragraphs: I am Mia, and my mom is a doctor. She works at the hospital in the town. Two years ago, she began to work there. She helps many sick people every day. Mom has a plan for every day. I write her Monday plan with the times in words. Snow, my white kitten, sleeps on the plan.

Mom wakes up at a quarter to six. She has breakfast at ten past six. She eats rice with an egg. She drinks a glass of water too. At twenty to seven, she leaves the house for work. At seven o'clock, she is at the hospital. Mom is never late. Her white coat is clean and long. She chats with her friends at a quarter past seven.

At eight o'clock, she sees the first patient. At twelve o'clock, she has a short lunch. At half past one, she sees more patients. She works hard all day. Some patients are children. At five minutes to five, she finishes work. She comes home at a quarter past five. In winter, it is dark at six o'clock. So Mom and I play badminton before dinner.

We eat dinner at half past six, and Dad cooks. In the evening, Mom reads a book. I sit next to her and read my book too. She is tired, but she is pleased with her day. At eight o'clock, we watch a cartoon together. Is it a long day for a doctor? Yes, it is, but she likes her work. At a quarter past nine, I go to bed. Mom says good night.
text.summary: Mia tells about the day of her mom, a doctor. Each part of the day has a time in words, from a quarter to six in the morning to a quarter past nine at night.
